  • Method Details

    • opensAt

      public static boolean opensAt(com.viaversion.viaversion.api.connection.UserConnection user, com.viaversion.viaversion.api.minecraft.BlockPosition position)
      Whether a block-position container open can show a menu at this position. Bedrock 1.26.60.5 ignores the open when the loaded chunk has no Chest, EnderChest, ShulkerBox or Barrel block actor there. An incomplete chunk cannot rule the block out yet, so binding resolves after it arrives.

    • logical

      public static ChestContainer logical(com.viaversion.viaversion.api.connection.UserConnection user, byte containerId, com.viaversion.viaversion.libs.mcstructs.text.TextComponent title, int size)
      Creates a variable-size actor container. Java receives enough chest rows for its visible prefix, up to 54 slots. The model and native presentation retain the complete metadata size.

    • slotFromRequest

      public int slotFromRequest(int slot)
      Item stack requests and responses carry a container slot as one byte, as the native client sends it: logical slot 487 becomes 231. A byte that names one logical slot resolves here. A byte shared by several slots returns -1; only the request that used it can say which slot it meant.
